description: This file defines classes related to code generation and file data management for a plugin system, including handling of headers, source code, CMake, JSON, and configuration data.

classes.name: FileData
classes.description: Base class for managing file data, including dynamic and static key generation, and namespace resolution.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: Handles header file data, including generating header-specific code snippets, interface entries, and notification handling.

classes.name: SourceData
classes.description: Manages source file data, including implementation details, plugin methods, and nested query logic.

classes.name: CMakeData
classes.description: Generates CMake build configuration snippets based on plugin properties.

classes.name: JSONData
classes.description: Handles JSON-related data, including references to header files and JSON configuration templates.

classes.name: ConfData
classes.description: Manages configuration data snippets for plugin startup modes and root configuration.

methods.name: commentParamnames
methods.description: Parses parameter strings, comments parameter names, and returns cleaned parameter list with names.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the keywords dictionary with dynamic, static, and extra keys.

methods.name: _generateHeaderIncludes
methods.description: Generates include statements for header files, including IDL and JSON variants.

methods.name: _generateSourceIncludeStatements
methods.description: Generates include statements for source files and configuration headers.

methods.name: _generateNestedQuery
methods.description: Creates nested interface query logic for plugin initialization.

methods.name: _generateDeinitializeOOP
methods.description: Generates code to deinitialize out-of-process plugin interfaces, including unregistering and releasing interfaces.
